drug_indication: Non-Squamous Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
catalyst_text: Reported positive updated Phase 2 results in mNSCLC
detailed_catalyst_text: Updated Phase 2 IOV-LUN-202 results in previously treated non-squamous mNSCLC reported a 24.6% ORR in 69 patients, consistent with earlier data, and a biomarker-enriched subgroup achieved a 59.1% ORR. A separate frontline cohort analysis (IOV-COM-202 Cohort 3A) showed an 85.7% ORR for the therapy plus pembrolizumab in KRAS wild-type ever-smokers. These clinical findings reinforce activity and support a biomarker-driven development strategy in mNSCLC.
catalyst_text_evidence: “As of the 2026-10-14 data cutoff, 17 of 69 patients responded, representing an ORR of 24.6%, consistent with the 25.6% ORR previously reported in 39 patients.” “A retrospective analysis identified a biomarker-enriched subgroup defined by Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog (KRAS) wild-type status, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) wild-type status, and current or former smoking…with an ORR of 59.1% (13 of 22 patients).” “In a separate analysis of frontline Cohort 3A of IOV-COM-202, six of seven patients with non-squamous mNSCLC, KRAS wild-type tumors, and a current or former smoking history responded to lifileucel plus pembrolizumab (without chemotherapy), yielding an ORR of 85.7%.”

catalyst_text: Presented positive pilot results at ESMO oral session
detailed_catalyst_text: An oral presentation at ESMO 2026 reported results from a pilot trial of lifileucel in metastatic undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma and dedifferentiated liposarcoma, showing a 50% confirmed ORR among eight evaluable patients with all responses ongoing at cutoff. The safety profile was consistent with prior experience, supporting further investigation in these high‑need sarcoma populations.
catalyst_text_evidence: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: IOVA), a commercial biotechnology company focused on innovating, developing, and delivering novel polyclonal tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with cancer, today announced that one-time lifileucel monotherapy demonstrated unprecedented efficacy with deep, durable responses across two difficult-to-treat soft tissue sarcomas with limited treatment options, metastatic UPS and DDLPS, in a pilot trial presented orally at the ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain. Among the first eight evaluable patients, physician-assessed confirmed ORR by RECIST v1.1 was 50%. Four partial responses (2 in UPS and 2 in DDLPS) were all ongoing (at 6+, 26+, 40+, and 46+ weeks) as of the data cut-off on 2026-09-09. The safety profile was consistent with the lifileucel treatment regimen across other indications.

catalyst_text: Reported positive final Phase 2 results at ESMO
detailed_catalyst_text: Final Phase 2 results from Cohort 1A of IOV-COM-202 showed a 62.5% ORR and 29.2% CR for the combination in frontline advanced melanoma, with median overall survival not reached at 50.9 months of follow-up. The data were presented in a Proffered Paper oral session at ESMO 2026, highlighting strong efficacy signals and supporting advancement in this setting.
catalyst_text_evidence: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:IOVA), a commercial biotechnology company focused on innovating, developing, and delivering novel polyclonal tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapies for patients with cancer, today announced that one-time lifileucel combined with pembrolizumab demonstrated a 62.5% ORR and a 29.2% CR rate, with median OS not reached at 50.9 months of median study follow-up in the final Phase 2 analysis in frontline advanced melanoma. The Phase 2 results were presented on 2026-10-23 in a Proffered Paper oral session at the ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain.

drug_indication: Advanced Colorectal Cancer, Triple-Negative Breast Cancer, Estrogen Receptor-Low Breast Cancer, Solid Tumors
catalyst_text: FDA allowed IND to proceed for basket trial
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA granted allowance to proceed for the IND supporting a Phase 1/2 basket trial of an IL-12 tethered TIL therapy. Planned cohorts include advanced colorectal, triple‑negative, and estrogen receptor‑low breast cancers, along with other prevalent solid tumors. This regulatory clearance enables initiation of first-in-human clinical testing in the U.S.
catalyst_text_evidence: "today announced allowance to proceed from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the investigational new drug (IND) application for a Phase 1/2 basket trial of IOV-5001, a next-generation interleukin-12 (IL-12) tethered TIL therapy." "Cohorts include advanced colorectal, triple-negative, and estrogen receptor-low breast cancers, as well as other highly prevalent solid tumors representing more than 100,000 U.S. deaths annually."

catalyst_text: Announced positive early data in advanced sarcomas
detailed_catalyst_text: Positive early results from a pilot clinical trial in advanced undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma and dedifferentiated liposarcoma were reported. Among the first six evaluable patients, confirmed ORR by RECIST v1.1 was 50% with responses deepening over time and a favorable safety profile. These findings suggest meaningful activity in a population with limited effective treatment options.
catalyst_text_evidence: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. ... today announced positive early data from a pilot clinical trial led by Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) and supported by Iovance of lifileucel in patients with advanced (metastatic or unresectable) undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma (UPS) or dedifferentiated liposarcoma (DDLPS) who were refractory to at least one prior line of systemic therapy. Among the first six evaluable patients treated with lifileucel monotherapy, physician-assessed confirmed ORR by RECIST v1.1 was 50%. Patients experienced deep responses that improved over time, consistent with lifileucel in melanoma, non-small-cell lung cancer, and other solid tumors. The safety profile was favorable and consistent with lifileucel therapy in other indications.

drug_indication: Cancer, 1L advanced non-small cell lung carcinoma
catalyst_text: 5/8/25- Trial ongoing. Cohort 3D results will inform registrational and confirmatory trial design.
The data from Phase 2 cohort 1a presented at ASCO indicated a confirmed complete response rate of 30%, as noted on November 8, 2024.
The Phase 2 data presented in the ASCO abstract indicated a confirmed ORR of 65.2%, which comprised 7 complete responses (30.4%) and 8 partial responses (34.8%), as reported on May 23, 2024.
The FDA granted approval on February 16, 2024.

drug_indication: Anti-PD-1 therapy for advanced (unresectable or metastatic) Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
catalyst_text: Initial findings from Phase 2 of the trial indicated that the median duration of response had not been achieved. The treatment-related adverse events were in line with the existing disease and recognized adverse events.
Information published on May 31, 2019 indicated an ORR of 44% and a CR of 11%.
